filter_size.description: Width over which the reconstruction filter combines samples

anisotropic_filter.description: Quality of anisotropic filtering in materials

taa_render_samples.description: Number of samples per pixel for rendering

use_taa_reprojection.description: Denoise image using temporal reprojection (can leave some ghosting)

use_shadow_jitter_viewport.description: Enable jittered shadows on the viewport. (Jittered shadows are always enabled for final renders).

volumetric_samples.description: Number of steps to compute volumetric effects. Higher step count increase VRAM usage and quality.

volumetric_sample_distribution.description: Distribute more samples closer to the camera

use_volumetric_shadows.description: Cast shadows from volumetric materials onto volumetric materials (Very expensive)

volumetric_shadow_samples.description: Number of samples to compute volumetric shadowing

use_bokeh_jittered.description: Jitter camera position to create accurate blurring using render samples (only for final render)

shadow_pool_size.description: Size of the shadow pool, a bigger pool size allows for more shadows in the scene but might not fit into GPU memory

shadow_ray_count.description: Amount of shadow ray to trace for each light

shadow_step_count.description: Amount of shadow map sample per shadow ray

denoising_prefilter.description: Prefilter noisy guiding (albedo and normal) passes to improve denoising quality when using OpenImageDenoise

preview_denoising_prefilter.description: Prefilter noisy guiding (albedo and normal) passes to improve denoising quality when using OpenImageDenoise

preview_denoising_start_sample.description: Sample to start denoising the preview at

samples.description: Number of samples to render for each pixel

preview_samples.description: Number of samples to render in the viewport, unlimited if 0

use_sample_subset.description: Render a subset of the specified max samples. Typically used for distributed rendering across multiple devices

sample_offset.description: 0-based index of sample to start rendering from

sample_subset_length.description: The number of samples to render in this subset

sampling_pattern.description: Random sampling pattern used by the integrator

use_layer_samples.description: How to use per view layer sample settings

light_sampling_threshold.description: Probabilistically terminate light samples when the light contribution is below this threshold (more noise but faster rendering). Zero disables the test and never ignores lights

use_adaptive_sampling.description: Automatically reduce the number of samples per pixel based on estimated noise level

adaptive_min_samples.description: Minimum AA samples for adaptive sampling, to discover noisy features before stopping sampling. Zero for automatic setting based on noise threshold

use_preview_adaptive_sampling.description: Automatically reduce the number of samples per pixel based on estimated noise level, for viewport renders

preview_adaptive_min_samples.description: Minimum AA samples for adaptive sampling, to discover noisy features before stopping sampling. Zero for automatic setting based on noise threshold, for viewport renders

direct_light_sampling_type.description: The type of strategy used for sampling direct light contributions

guiding_directional_sampling_type.description: Type of the directional sampling used for guiding

guiding_training_samples.description: The maximum number of samples used for training path guiding. Higher samples lead to more accurate guiding, however may also unnecessarily slow down rendering once guiding is accurate enough. A value of 0 will continue training until the last sample

sample_clamp_direct.description: If non-zero, the maximum value for a direct sample, higher values will be scaled down to avoid too much noise and slow convergence at the cost of accuracy

sample_clamp_indirect.description: If non-zero, the maximum value for an indirect sample, higher values will be scaled down to avoid too much noise and slow convergence at the cost of accuracy
